decisions.reason: The source expands the reusable AI prompt across grades but does not resume or change the deferred C# random-generator requirement.
Using a prompt for all grades does not change curriculum-alignment rules or resolve which topics belong in Grade 5.
The prompt's grade coverage does not change the established rules for gradual progression or curriculum-block-based skill splitting.
The source does not change how an existing question is copied into each applicable level.
The reusable prompt's all-grade scope does not change per-level visual object requirements or any specified object type.
Making prompt-based generation easier across grades does not change the review sequence or the requirement for three questions per level.
